description: This source file contains utility helper methods for managing custom datatypes within the OpenMRS project, including datatype retrieval, handler management, configuration serialization, and validation.

classes.name: CustomDatatypeUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static helper methods for managing custom datatypes and their handlers, including retrieval, configuration, serialization, and validation.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Returns a configured CustomDatatype based on the descriptor's class name and configuration.

methods.name: getDatatypeOrDefault
methods.description: Returns a CustomDatatype from a descriptor, or the default datatype if an error occurs.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a CustomDatatypeHandler based on the datatype, preferred handler class name, and configuration.

methods.name: serializeSimpleConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes a map of simple configuration key-value pairs into a string.

methods.name: deserializeSimpleConfiguration
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a map of key-value configuration pairs.

methods.name: getValueReferences
methods.description: Converts attribute values to their reference string representations using the appropriate datatypes.

methods.name: getDatatypeClassnames
methods.description: Retrieves all registered datatype class names.

methods.name: getHandlerClassnames
methods.description: Retrieves all registered handler class names.

methods.name: isCompatibleHandler
methods.description: Checks if a handler is compatible with a specific datatype.

methods.name: saveAttributesIfNecessary
methods.description: Saves all attributes of a customizable object if they are marked as dirty.

methods.name: saveIfDirty
methods.description: Saves a SingleCustomValue if it is marked as dirty, updating its value reference.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a SingleCustomValue against its datatype configuration.
